title: Dynamic Networks with Node Heterogeneity and Homophily
summary: The goal of this paper is to model node heterogeneity and link homophily for dynamic networks. The proposed framework brings new insights on how networks evolve over time. It also provides more sophisticated tools for the prediction of future networks with statistical guarantees. The new model accounts for the link homophily associated with both observed traits and latent traits.
